respuesta.razonamiento: The visual diagram and narration describe an end-to-end data ingestion and analytics pipeline. Smart TVs emit logs directly into Amazon Kinesis Data Streams, which feeds into Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose. Firehose loads data into Amazon Redshift for data warehouse querying and backs it up into Amazon S3 for long-term storage. Amazon QuickSight queries Amazon Redshift using SPICE (an integrated in-memory feature of QuickSight, merged into the QuickSight node). Casual mention of end users was omitted as they were neither drawn nor involved in explicit diagrammed flows.
respuesta.nombre: Smart TV Telemetry and Analytics Pipeline with Kinesis, Redshift, and QuickSight
